issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: General 18,140, Street 1,333, Fire 78,892 (p1), Park 525 (p2)
issues.issue: Governmental 'Local Receipts: Other' (98,890) is about 58% of governmental receipts (169,491) and is unexplained. The Fire Fund's 78,892 is that fund's only receipt. It could be rural fire contracts, a grant, or loan proceeds. The line is recorded as 'other' with a review note, but there is no decision_needed[] entry.

issues.on_page: Debt Service Fund line 50 transfer out 6,025; p5 schedule: 'Water Bond Fund' to Water Fund 6,025
issues.issue: The p5 schedule calls the 'Debt Service Fund' column the Water Bond Fund, so it is probably part of the water enterprise. The extractor treated it as governmental: 6,025 is in the governmental beginning cash and transfers_out, and business_type.transfers_net is -1,002. If the column is business-type, governmental beginning cash would be 507,277 and transfers_out 12,479, and business-type would net +5,023 with beginning 42,749. Both versions reconcile; the classification is an assumption.
The page prints only 'Other'. Treating the utility columns' amount as utility charges is an assumption (the line already has a review note).

issues.on_page: Line 24 Ending Balance 549,859; line 28 Subtotal of Ending Balances 549,859
issues.issue: The equity line uses the line 28 asset subtotal label. Line 24 'Ending Balance' is the balance line itself. The amounts are the same.
